verdict.rationale: Visa documents spending limits and mandate management for agent payments. The purchase-intent mandate carries a required declineThreshold amount and an effectiveUntilTime expiry, and VisaNet enforces network-level controls on amount and merchant. Agent-specific tokens have documented lifecycle management, and an agent can cancel a purchase intent. However, caps are scoped per instruction/mandate rather than as standing per-agent budgets, revocation is only shown as cancelling a single intent, and the product is flagged as still in development. Missing for 10: standing per-agent spend caps and frequency/usage limits, an explicit instant revocation of an agent's token or payment authority, independent or hands-on corroboration.
